stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

on the last line of your reply:

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    vertical=any(sum(grid[r][c]!=0 for r in range(h))>=2 for c in range(w))
    # Horizontal patterns.
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        if vertical: break
        pts=[(c,row[c]) for c in range(w) if row[c]]
        if len(pts)<2: continue
        same=[(a,b) for i,a in enumerate(pts) for b in pts[i+1:] if a[1]==b[1]]
        if not same: continue
        a,b=max(same,key=lambda ab:ab[1][0]-ab[0][0])
        step=b[0]-a[0]
        other=[p for p in pts if p not in (a,b)]
        out[r]=[0]*w
        if other:
            s,col=other[0]
            end=max(a[0],b[0],s)
            direction=1 if max(a[0],b[0])>s else -1
            p=s
            while 0<=p<=end:
                if 0<=p<w: out[r][p]=col
                p+=direction*step
        else:
            # Continue the pair away from the nearest border/through the grid.
            if b[0]*2>=w:
                p=b[0]
                while p>=0:
                    out[r][p]=a[1]; p-=step
            else:
                p=a[0]
                while p<w:
                    out[r][p]=a[1]; p+=step
    # Vertical patterns, only where horizontal processing did not apply.
    for c in range(w):
        pts=[(r,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) if grid[r][c]]
        if len(pts)<2: continue
        if not vertical: continue
        same=[(a,b) for i,a in enumerate(pts) for b in pts[i+1:] if a[1]==b[1]]
        if not same: continue
        for r in range(h): out[r][c]=0
        if len(pts)==3 and len(same)==1 and pts[0][1]!=pts[1][1] and pts[1][0]-pts[0][0]==pts[2][0]-pts[1][0]:
            for r in range(0,h,(h-1)//2): out[r][c]=pts[0][1]
        else:
            a,b=same[0]; step=b[0]-a[0]; col=a[1]
            p=b[0]

code='''def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    hp=sum(sum(row.count(v)>=2 for v in range(1,10)) for row in grid)
    vp=sum(sum([grid[r][c] for r in range(h)].count(v)>=2 for v in range(1,10)) for c in range(w))
    vertical=vp>hp
    if not vertical:
        for r,row in enumerate(grid):
            pts=[(c,row[c]) for c in range(w) if row[c]]
            same=[(a,b) for i,a in enumerate(pts) for b in pts[i+1:] if a[1]==b[1]]
            if not same: continue
            a,b=max(same,key=lambda ab:ab[1][0]-ab[0][0])
            step=b[0]-a[0]
            positions=list(range(a[0]%step,w,step))
            color=a[1]
            other=[p for p in pts if p not in (a,b)]
            if other and other[0][0] in positions: color=other[0][1]
            out[r]=[0]*w
            for p in positions: out[r][p]=color
            for p,col in pts:
                if p not in positions: out[r][p]=col
    else:
        for c in range(w):
            pts=[(r,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) if grid[r][c]]
            same=[(a,b) for i,a in enumerate(pts) for b in pts[i+1:] if a[1]==b[1]]
            if not same: continue
            a,b=same[0]; step=b[0]-a[0]
            positions=list(range(a[0]%step,h,step))
            color=a[1]
            other=[p for p in pts if p not in (a,b)]
            if other and other[0][0] in positions: color=other[0][1]
            for r in range(h): out[r][c]=0
            for p in positions: out[p][c]=color
            for p,col in pts:
                if p not in positions: out[p][c]=col
    return out
'''
